author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live stream excerpt Adam Savage answers Tested member questions about the realities of fitting costumes to your body and stepping outside your comfort zone to learn brand-new maker skills, such as sewing. Plus, Adam shares his personal routine for health and weight management, why your first attempt at a project should fail, and a classic maker rant on the state of sewing patterns and large-format printing. With thanks to Gwen-Maker-of-Things and TheElderCryptid for their questions and support! How do you maintain your weight?
